taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空接收第五架A350-1000　B-58555自土魯斯啟程返台
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空第五架Airbus A350-1000客機B-58555，於2026年10月16日在法國完成交付。航空交機追蹤平台Aviation Flights的紀錄顯示，該機隨後執行交機航班SJX2351，於台北時間10月17日凌晨1時28分，自法國土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場（TLS）起飛，前往台灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。交付日期與返台起飛日期因時差而分屬不同日。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: STARLUX Takes Delivery of Fifth A350-1000 as B-58555 Departs Toulouse for Taiwan
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: STARLUX Airlines took delivery of its fifth Airbus A350-1000, registered B-58555, in France on October 16, 2026. Aviation Flights records show that the aircraft subsequently operated delivery flight SJX2351, departing Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) for Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) at 1:28 a.m. Taipei time on October 17. The delivery and departure dates fall on different calendar days because of the time difference.

sources.name: Airbus — STARLUX takes delivery of first Airbus A350-1000

international_aviation.headline: PlaneSense規劃為71架Pilatus飛機加裝Gogo衛星Wi-Fi
international_aviation.summary: PlaneSense規劃在2027年底前，為旗下全部71架Pilatus飛機加裝Gogo Galileo衛星Wi-Fi。PlaneSense於2026年10月15日宣佈選定該系統，協議涵蓋現有機隊及未來交付的飛機。
international_aviation.headline_en: PlaneSense plans Galileo satellite Wi-Fi for all 71 Pilatus aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: PlaneSense plans to equip all 71 of its Pilatus aircraft with Gogo Galileo satellite Wi-Fi by the end of 2027. PlaneSense announced its selection of the system on October 15, 2026. The agreement covers its current fleet and future aircraft deliveries. The aircraft include PC-12 turboprops and PC-24 jets.

international_aviation.summary: 達美航空宣佈新增波士頓與雷克雅維克之間的波音757-200航班。Simple Flying的報導摘要將這項安排列入2027年新的跨大西洋航班時刻表，並稱其可延伸波士頓的歐洲航網。
international_aviation.headline_en: Delta Announces New Boeing 757-200 Flights Between Boston and Reykjavík
international_aviation.summary_en: Delta Air Lines has announced new Boeing 757-200 flights between Boston and Reykjavík. Simple Flying’s summary places the flights in a new 2027 transatlantic schedule and says the schedule extends Boston’s European reach.

international_aviation.summary: 捷藍航空（JetBlue）計畫於12月在3條航線推出BlueFirst。相關航班已開放購票，並提供導入優惠票價。
international_aviation.headline_en: JetBlue plans December BlueFirst debut on three routes with introductory fares
international_aviation.summary_en: Simple Flying reports that JetBlue plans to debut BlueFirst in December on three routes. Flights are on sale with introductory fares. The report's summary describes flexible BlueFirst bundles that pair priority bags and boarding with an elevated in-cabin experience on the launch routes.

international_aviation.headline: 義大利航管資料網路故障後恢復全數空運能量
international_aviation.summary: 義大利於2026年10月16日恢復全數空中交通容量。當日稍早，資料網路故障迫使航管單位大幅降低容量，導致全國旅客面臨航班延誤與取消。
international_aviation.headline_en: Italy restores full air traffic capacity after data network failure disrupts flights
international_aviation.summary_en: Italy restored full air traffic capacity on October 16, 2026, after a data network failure earlier in the day forced controllers to sharply reduce capacity, leaving passengers facing delays and cancellations across the country.

international_aviation.headline: FAA擬取得AI空管系統開發商股權，初步條款仍在協商
international_aviation.summary: 根據內部機關文件，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）正尋求取得 Air Space Intelligence 的股權；該公司正在開發新的人工智慧支援空中交通管理系統。報導所述的初步條款包括讓政府以固定價格購買股份，FAA目前正就這項安排進行協商。該公司於2026年6月取得FAA合約，負責開發兩套相連的空中交通管理系統。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA seeks stake in Air Space Intelligence, with terms still preliminary
international_aviation.summary_en: the FAA is seeking an ownership stake in Air Space Intelligence, which is developing a new AI-supported air traffic management system. The reported preliminary terms would allow the government to buy shares at a set price, and the FAA is negotiating the arrangement. The company won an FAA contract in June 2026 to develop two connected systems for managing air traffic.
